notes.title: 10 New Levels Released!
notes.content: [h2]Update 1.1.0 is here![/h2][p][/p][h3]This new update includes:[/h3][list][*][p][b]New Level Pack:[/b] Featuring 10 new levels. Unlock it by getting knocked over 3 times in a row without standing up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Unlockable Outfit: [/b]A new outfit which can be unlocked by playing a match with all modifiers enabled (all modifiers need to be unlocked for this to be possible).[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Feature: [/b]We found it difficult to keep track of who is who sometimes, so we added the ability to see the names of players above their characters at any time by holding shift on keyboard, or Y or triangle on controller.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Item Spawner:[/b] An item spawner that works like a dispenser has been added to some of the new levels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Widescreen support:[/b] Fixed a bug where you used to be able to see the edges of the water when playing on an ultrawide monitor. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes: [/b]Fixed a bug where decals used to be floating in the air when a player had left the tutorial level, along with some other[b] [/b]minor bugs.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Music, Japanese, Russian, and a vote
notes.content: [p]The new update for the game brings 3 new songs to be played during gameplay.[/p][p]We also added support for Japanese and Russian language since we noticed that there were some players from these countries.[/p][p][/p][p]We're making 10 new levels for the next level pack, but we can't decide on what theme to make them. Which theme would you prefer?[/p][list][*][p]Bouncy Castle theme - Everything is made out of bouncy castle, and everything bounces on it[/p][/*][*][p]Pinball Game theme - The levels look like pinball machines, with interactive flippers and other obstacles to bounce around on[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Join the official Dazed Games [url="https://discord.gg/GSsBCaZdyx"]Discord[/url] to vote![/p]

notes.title: YOU NOW OWN OUT OF HAND DELUXE!
notes.content: [p][b]AYOOOOO[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Out of Hand Deluxe is finally here![/p][p][/p][p]Everyone who played the original [b]Out of Hand[/b] game has been given [b]Out of Hand Deluxe[/b] for free as a thank-you for playing our game![/p][p][/p][p]Here's what the Deluxe version features compared to the original[/p][list][*][p][b]Online Multiplayer PvP![/b] Play against your friends over the internet[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unlockable Content![/b] Linked to Steam Achievements, you can now unlock multiple outfits, level packs and modifiers to spice up the gameplay[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Items![/b] Discover more items across all levels[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Levels![/b] More than 20 new levels to play on[/p][/*][*][p][b]Level Design Overhaul![/b] All levels have been updated with improved gameplay and prettier models[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Gameplay![/b] We've tweaked gamplay for a smoother game feel and more consistent experience[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Graphics![/b] Better lighting and more decorations[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improved Item Interaction![/b] More feedback with item iteractions as well as easy interaction mode for new players[/p][/*][*][p][b]Better Optimization![/b] Now supports customizable settings for lower-end computers[/p][/*][*][p][b]Updated Character Design![/b] More outfits with more clothes on[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization![/b] Now available in Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: The Modification Update
notes.content:
Hello there,

For the fourth demo version for Out of Hand Deluxe we are adding 7 modification options:
[list]
[*] Movement speed
[*] Arm length
[*] Slippery socks
[*] Random items in spawners
[*] Banana mode
[*] Ammo capacity
[*] Insane Recoil
[/list]

You can now try them out on 10 different levels instead of 5. One game is also 10 rounds instead of 5. Some bugfixes and quality of life improvements have been added as well:
[list]
[*] Shows keybinds for easy mode and interaction mode in the tutorial
[*] Improved table UI
[*] Added modifications section in the table UI
[*] Added VIP section in the menu for those invited by the developers
[*] Minor bugfixes
[/list]

Bye

notes.title: Localization Update
notes.content:
Hello,

For the third demo version for Out of Hand Deluxe we are focusing on localization. 5 new languages are now supported: Swedish, Spanish, Portuguese, and Simplified & Traditional Chinese. 

We've also done a few smaller bugfixes and some updates:
[list]
[*]Changed font to enable support for all languages
[*]5 different maps to play on
[*]Invincibility for half a second when dodging
[*]Sound effects for steps, dodge, item pick up and some ambient
[*]Trail effect when dodging
[*]More accurate outfit names
[/list]

That's about it

notes.title: The Outfit Update
notes.content:
Hello,

This is the second demo version for Out of Hand Deluxe. This version includes all things available in the first one plus:
[list]
[*]8 updated outfits (we gave them clothes, skintones and genders)
[*]5 new outfits unlockable with achievements
[*]5 different maps to play on
[*]A new island menu for all playable outfits and how to unlock them
[*]Added a scoreboard that shows up every third round
[*]Made the characters do a flip when dodging
[*]Proper support for 8 players locally
[*]Upgraded the engine to Unity 6
[*]Removed "Made in Unity" logo
[*]Added more graphics settings
[*]Added pitch variations to most sound effects
[/list]

Goodbye

notes.title: Demo Available!
notes.content:
Hello,

Welcome to the first of many demo versions for Out of Hand Deluxe. This demo is available to test a few new things in Out of Hand but mainly the new Online Multiplayer feature. You can now play on 5 selected levels with up to 8 players over the internet. 

We are going to update this demo multiple times before launch in order to remove as many bugs as we can. Please give us any feedback you have for us to improve the game. 

Here is our Discord server: https://discord.gg/N9bfGzNP4J

Have fun
